name: Pristine Spider Silk
summary: In Stormwind, High Sorcerer Andromath sends rising Alliance mages to Duskwood for pristine spider silk. They bring eight samples to Wynne Larson in the Mage Quarter, where she makes a robe for an adept.

sections.title: Vestments of the Adept
sections.body: High Sorcerer Andromath marks a mage’s passage beyond apprenticeship with vestments fit for an adept. In the Wizard’s Sanctum, arcane mastery is matched by the robes its practitioners wear. Rather than buy finished garments, the mage must show field skill and discernment by taking pristine, unblemished silk from dangerous spiders.

sections.title: The Loom of Duskwood
sections.body: Venomous carrion recluse spiders haunt Duskwood’s gloomy woods, and their silk is not sold at ordinary stalls. You gather eight prime samples and carry them across Stormwind to Larson Clothiers in the Mage Quarter. There, Wynne Larson uses the delicate threads to weave a robe with arcane significance.

faq.q: Who sends mages on this assignment?
faq.answer: High Sorcerer Andromath, who presides over the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City, sends spellcasters who have proved their dedication.

aliases: where do i get pristine silk
faq.answer: You gather the silk from carrion recluse spiders in Duskwood’s haunted forests and webbed clearings.

faq.q: Who crafts the robe from the silk?
faq.answer: Wynne Larson, a tailor at Larson Clothiers in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter, weaves and tailors the robe.

faq.q: Why do mages use spider silk for garments?
faq.answer: Pristine spider silk is naturally resilient and finely woven, making lightweight fabric that can hold subtle enchantments without weighing down a spellcaster.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the silk?
aliases: next quest after pristine spider silk
faq.answer: After Wynne inspects the silk and works at her loom, she presents the mage with the finished Astral Knot Garment.

faq.q: Is any spider silk from Duskwood acceptable?
aliases: can i use regular spider silk
faq.answer: No. Larson Clothiers needs pristine samples carefully taken from carrion recluses for its delicate enchantments; coarser webbing will not do.

angles.text: As a mage, you pass from apprenticeship to adept status through this rite. Every Stormwind mage wears robes woven from hazards they have faced themselves.
As a tailor, you can see how Wynne Larson turns high-grade wild monster fibers into fabric that takes enchantments better than common wool or linen.
As an Alliance subject, you leave Stormwind’s sanctuary for dangerous Duskwood to gather a rare resource from the region.
